study.title: C7: magnitude-based and direction-wise acceptance of constraint-preserving corrections for multi-joint arm world models
research_questions: RQ1: Does accepting a correction by the size of its loss change (an upper confidence bound on the mean relative loss) recover safe gains that the strict count rule of C1 gave up on a 7-DOF arm?
RQ2: Do accepted corrections stay harmless in-distribution under the magnitude rule on every system?
RQ3: Does direction-wise partial acceptance (fixed-sequence testing over eigen-directions of the contraction) accept more useful corrections than whole-matrix acceptance?
RQ4: What do the judge-set size (36 vs 100) and a tail condition cost or buy, and what happens under range widening (not covered by the guarantee)?

seeds.reason: 34 new seeds (mod 1000 = 901..999, unused by every earlier protocol including C1 = 11..313). Power: seed-level sd of the 7-DOF ID gain of the always-on contraction in C1 was 0.058 (used as a pilot value; the gated gain has more zeros, so 0.079 from the 2-DOF pilot is used as a conservative sd)

stats.correction_reason: Holm over the confirmatory p-value claims (N1, N3); N2 is bound-based per system; N4/N5 are descriptive

budget.hardware: Apple M5 Max 128GB (primary, parallel cases) via Claude Code; Linux 1 CPU core for a reduced smoke subset and a cross-platform decision check
budget.tuning_reason: No tuning on test data; candidate fitting and lambda selection identical to C1 (C_s1); gate thresholds fixed in advance here

datasets.name: planar_2link
datasets.source: same generator, prior, truth and settings as C1 (impl/c1/c1_models.py, c1_config.json) with the C7 seeds
datasets.split: per run: train 12/36, C_f 12, C_s1 12, judge 100 (first 36 = small-judge variant), test 48 ID + 48 range widening

methods.name: mag_dir_gate
methods.source: this work: rule (1) magnitude gate (one-sided 95% betting upper confidence bound, Waudby-Smith and Ramdas 2024, on the mean of min(ratio, 2)/2 over the n = 100 judge episodes (primary); accept iff bound <= (1 + tau)/2, tau = 0; no tail condition in the primary rule) applied by rule (2) fixed-sequence testing over the eigen-directions of A - I ordered by their C_s1 loss reduction; the accepted prefix gives A_S = I + sum_{j in S} (lambda_j - 1) v_j v_j^T, which stays symmetric with eigenvalues in [0, 1] (Proposition 1 keeps the linear constraints)

methods.name: strict_ltt_c1
methods.source: C1 rule: whole C_s1-best candidate, accept iff Clopper-Pearson upper bound on P(episode worse) <= 0.1 with 36 judge episodes
methods.why: the rule whose conservativeness C7 addresses; same cases

methods.name: mean_loss_rule
methods.source: apply the C_s1-best candidate if it lowers the C_s1 loss by 1% (no finite-sample test)
methods.why: simplest validation rule; shows what the guarantee costs

methods.name: equal_budget_retrain
methods.why: most accurate alternative when weights are available

methods.name: always_on
methods.why: upper reference for the gain a gate can recover

claims.claim: On franka_7dof in-distribution, mag_dir_gate gives a median per-run relative gain over keep_Z of at least 5% (rejected runs count as 0)
claims.min_effect_reason: same threshold as C1-M3, so the two rules are judged by the same bar; below 5% a deployer would not pay for the observed judge episodes
claims.falsify_if: lower end of the seed-cluster bootstrap 95% interval below 0.05: not supported
claims.expected: 기대(결과 아님): 불확실(파일럿 12 케이스에서 Franka 승인 일부)

claims.claim: Per system, among runs where mag_dir_gate applies a correction, the share whose in-distribution test mean ratio (mean over test episodes of min(ratio, 2)) exceeds 1 is at most 0.10
claims.min_effect_reason: epsilon-level guarantee of rule (1) translated to runs; 0.10 matches delta of C1
claims.falsify_if: per system: fewer than 10 runs with an applied correction: inconclusive; not supported if the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LOWER bound exceeds 0.10; supported if the one-sided 95% UPPER bound is at most 0.10; inconclusive otherwise

claims.claim: On franka_7dof, direction-wise acceptance applies a correction in more runs than whole-matrix acceptance under the same magnitude rule, by at least 10% of runs
claims.min_effect_reason: 14 of 136 runs; fewer would not justify the extra procedure
claims.falsify_if: difference below 10% of runs or Holm-adjusted one-sided exact McNemar p >= 0.05: not supported

claims.claim: Descriptive: acceptance rates and median gains of all gates per system; the 36-episode judge variant and the tail-condition variant (P(ratio > 1.1) Clopper-Pearson upper bound <= 0.2); comparison with C1's strict rule on the same cases
claims.min_effect_reason: descriptive; a 10-point change in acceptance rate between gates or judge sizes would change design advice
claims.falsify_if: descriptive; reported as observed without a verdict
claims.expected: 기대(결과 아님): 엄격 규칙보다 승인 증가

claims.claim: Descriptive: under range widening (not covered by the guarantee), the share of runs with an applied correction that become worse than keep_Z, per system and gate
claims.min_effect_reason: descriptive; one accepted run in ten made worse under range widening would be operationally relevant
claims.falsify_if: descriptive; reported as observed without a verdict
claims.expected: 기대(결과 아님): 평면 팔에서 악화 발생 가능

rules: 예산의 80% 초과 시 seed를 줄이지 않고 학습 크기 설정 하나를 줄인 뒤 기록
